design_concept: Neo-Claymorphism CRM for Founders - Tactile, warm, and highly functional without the coldness of typical B2B SaaS.

surfaces_and_shadows.clay_button: bg-[#D35C3E] text-white rounded-full shadow-[inset_0_-4px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15),0_6px_16px_rgba(211,92,62,0.25)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform font-bold px-6 py-2.5
surfaces_and_shadows.clay_input: bg-[#F5F3EF] rounded-2xl shadow-[inset_4px_4px_8px_rgba(42,35,31,0.04),inset_-4px_-4px_8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] border-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D35C3E]/50 px-4 py-3 text-[#2A231F] placeholder:text-[#70655B]/60

components.sidebar: Separated floating panel: m-4 h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] w-64 clay_card flex flex-col justify-between fixed left-0 top-0
components.topbar: Floating header inside the main content area, sticky top-4 z-40 mb-8 clay_card px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
components.avatar: Rounded-full, thick white border for pop (border-2 border-white shadow-sm object-cover)
components.network_graph: Render inside a clay_card. Use D3.js force-directed graph (via react-force-graph-2d or d3 directly). Nodes are circles with investor images or initials. Edges are thin curved lines (stroke: #E09A36). Transparent background for SVG.
components.kanban_board: Columns have a subtle inset shadow background (bg-[#F5F3EF] rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-inner). Cards inside are standard `clay_card` with `cursor-grab`. On drag: scale-105 shadow-xl.
components.empty_states: Use Lucide icons (size 48, strokeWidth 1.5, text-[#70655B]) centered in a clay_card with dashed borders instead of solid shadows, plus a friendly caption.
components.draft_split_view: Left sidebar for drafts (bg-transparent, list items have hover:bg-white/50 rounded-xl). Right side is the composer (clay_card with rich text input area).
components.loading_skeletons: Use bg-[#EBE7E0] animate-pulse rounded-xl for text blocks and rounded-full for avatars.

media.logo_mark: Use Lucide-React 'Sparkles' or 'Aperture' icon in Terracotta (#D35C3E) surrounded by a soft clay rounded square for the Relio brand mark.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML divs with the custom Tailwind classes provided in `surfaces_and_shadows` instead of generic Shadcn cards to ensure the Claymorphism look.
Implement routing for all requested views: Dashboard, Contacts, Detail Page, Kanban, Graph, Drafts, Settings, Auth.
For the Network Graph, use D3.js force simulation on an SVG or Canvas. Keep it interactive (zoom/pan, hover tooltips).
Install `@dnd-kit/core` or `@hello-pangea/dnd` for the Pipeline Kanban Board drag-and-drop feature.
Tables should avoid harsh vertical borders. Use generous padding (py-4) and subtle horizontal dividers (border-b border-black/5).
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).
Never use pure black or default Tailwind blues/grays. Stick strictly to the warm palette provided in the colors object.
The Auth page should be a split screen: left side is the `auth_background` image with an overlay, right side is the login form centered inside a `clay_card`.
Include hover states for all buttons and interactive table rows. Button hover should use `primary_hover` color and slightly elevate.
